description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the named subarea. Park-property polygons and matching centroids describe county, city and other park facilities. Shared PropertyID and facility attributes identify public accessibility, restrooms, parking, paved/unpaved trails, community centres, playgrounds and sports facilities. These source-defined assets, service areas or operating constraints provide inputs for capacity planning studies. The paired geometries share one property inventory and are grouped. The inventory also includes habitat and natural areas; facility flags do not establish capacity or current condition. Access is through the public county catalogue and ArcGIS REST layer metadata, with GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile export descriptors advertised by the provider. No feature records or files were downloaded. Licence terms are referred to a county PDF that was not opened; charges are not stated. The additional county GIS metadata HTML route failed during TLS negotiation. A limitation is that field definitions do not establish attribute completeness, present serviceability or observation dates. A regular update frequency is not stated. No exact related active resource was established for this group.
